verdict.rationale: Clerk documents machine authentication as a first-party feature: API keys authenticate programmatic callers and M2M tokens authenticate calls between agents, with dedicated machine-auth docs pages. The pricing page also lists "API Keys & M2M Tokens" as a metered platform feature on every plan, so services and agents can authenticate without a human. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a standards-based OAuth client-credentials grant, details on issuing, rotating and verifying M2M tokens, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
